title: Quest Foglight for Databases AbstractParser XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure… (CVE-2026-92185)
description: CVE-2026-92185 is an XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases affecting the AbstractParser class. It allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information without authentication by exploiting improper restriction of XML external entity references. The vulnerability can lead to information disclosure with SYSTEM-level context.
